fields.title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds
fields.authors: MAHYAR KARGAR; BENJAMIN LESTER; SÉBASTIEN PLANTE; PIERRE‐OLIVIER WEILL
fields.abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.
